title: 海水淡化取水工程~Seawater-desalination intake works
focus: 取水水量、生物介面與海岸水力驗證~Intake balances, biological interfaces and coastal hydraulic verification
summary: 本課由淡化回收率推導取水需求，依序分析篩網法向流速、有效面積、管路損失及潮位吸入裕度，再比較地下取水、堵塞、海管浮力與生物暴露。最後將排放回流接回進水水質，要求每個算例保留控制體、單位及適用邊界，不將平均值直接當成生態或設備允收結論。~Starting from desalination recovery, this course develops intake demand through screen-normal velocity, effective area, losses and tidal suction margin, then examines subsurface collection, clogging, pipe buoyancy and biological exposure. Outfall recirculation closes the feed-quality loop. Every example retains its control volume, units and limits rather than converting an average into ecological or equipment acceptance.

units.anchor: 產水需求與取水總量~Product demand and intake volume
units.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證~Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。若只用產品容量選擇取水口，可能低估海管、篩網與抽水負荷；不同流程的回收率定義須明確標示是膜段或全廠，避免重複或漏算支流。本例只對膜段作水量守恆，忽略密度差及其他支流；不能把得到的進水流量直接當成全廠海水取水設計值。~A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output. Recovery links membrane product and feed, while pretreatment sludge, backwash and other streams can increase total intake. Sizing an intake from product capacity alone can understate pipeline, screen and pumping loads. Recovery definitions must distinguish the membrane stage from the entire plant to avoid omitting or double-counting side streams. The example applies volume balance to the membrane stage only, neglecting density differences and side streams. Its feed flow is not automatically the complete plant intake design flow.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Feed Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s and concentrate Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s.
units.verify: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。核對回收率的實際控制體，將膜段水量帳與全廠取水帳分開驗證後再合併。~Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows. Verify the recovery control volume and validate membrane and whole-plant balances separately against synchronized flow-meter records before combining them.
units.failure: 把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。~Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. Higher recovery can also increase concentrate salinity, so it is not simply a one-directional intake benefit.
units.misconception: 淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。~A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow.
units.practice: 畫出膜段與全廠兩個控制體，分別填入相同產品需求和假設回收率。逐一指出尚未計量的支流，並說明哪些額外資料會改變海管容量估計。~Draw membrane and whole-plant control volumes using the same product demand and assumed recovery. Identify unmetered side streams and explain which additional information would alter the intake-pipeline estimate.

units.anchor: 接近流速與篩網面積~Approach velocity and screen area
units.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證~Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 取水口附近流場包含垂直篩面的接近分量及沿篩面的掃流分量，兩者對生物暴露的意義不同。增加有效過水面積可降低平均法向流速，但局部堵塞、潮流與幾何不均仍會產生較高速度；生物保護還取決於物種、生命階段與孔隙尺寸，不能只用平均流速保證無影響。以下面積為有效法向過水面積，尚未換算成外框尺寸或考慮局部不均；假設流速只供計算，不代表任何物種或許可標準。~Flow near an intake includes approach velocity normal to the screen and sweeping velocity parallel to it, with different implications for biological exposure. More effective area lowers mean normal velocity, but blockage, currents and uneven geometry can produce local peaks. Protection also depends on species, life stage and opening size, so mean velocity alone cannot prove absence of impact. The area is effective normal flow area, not gross frame dimensions, and local nonuniformity is omitted. The assumed velocity is a calculation input, not a species or permit criterion.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s. Required effective area Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m².
units.verify: 以流場量測或核定模型分開法向與沿篩速度，覆蓋不同潮位、海流與部分堵塞情境。將有效面積、孔隙及物種調查一起核對，驗證局部峰值而不只比較全篩平均。~Separate normal and sweeping velocities using field measurements or an approved model across tides, currents and partial blockage. Check effective area, openings and biological surveys together, evaluating local peaks rather than only the screen-wide average.
units.failure: 篩網平均速度符合假設時，局部窄縫仍可能形成高速吸入或生物附著區；若把掃流速度誤當接近速度，生物暴露評估會失去正確方向。~Local constrictions can create high-speed entry or impingement even when average velocity matches the assumption. Confusing sweeping with approach velocity removes the directional basis needed for biological-exposure assessment.
units.misconception: 篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。~Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected.
units.practice: 為同一取水量畫出均勻與局部堵塞兩種速度分布，指出平均值掩蓋的區域。將水理結果與特定物種證據分開列出，再說明兩者如何共同支持設計比較。~Draw uniform and locally blocked velocity distributions for one flow, identifying regions hidden by the average. Present hydraulic results separately from species evidence and explain how they jointly support design comparison.

units.anchor: 孔隙率與堵塞餘量~Open area and blockage allowance
units.title: 孔隙率與堵塞餘量機理與驗證~Open area and blockage allowance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 篩網外框面積不等於真正可供水流穿過的面積，構件遮蔽、孔隙率與生物污損會逐層減少開口。清潔時的水力條件只能作起點，運轉後局部沉積可能改變流量分配和清理需求；若所有堵塞都假設均勻，仍可能漏掉小區域的高流速與高壓差。本例將孔隙率與剩餘通暢比例相乘，假設兩者定義不重複；若廠商有效面積已含遮蔽，不可再扣同一項。~Gross screen area differs from the area actually available to flow. Structural blockage, open-area ratio and biological fouling progressively reduce openings. Clean-screen hydraulics provide only a starting point, since deposits change flow distribution and cleaning demand. Treating all blockage as uniform can still miss localized high velocities and pressure differences. The example multiplies open-area ratio by remaining unblocked fraction, assuming nonoverlapping definitions. If a manufacturer’s effective area already includes an obstruction, it must not be deducted again.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外框A=20 m²、孔隙率φ=0.60、通暢比例β=0.75，Aeff=Aφβ=9.0 m²；Q=1.20 m³/s時vn=0.1333 m/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross A=20 m², open-area ratio φ=0.60 and unblocked fraction β=0.75. Aeff=Aφβ=9.0 m²; at Q=1.20 m³/s, vn=0.1333 m/s.
units.verify: 保存清潔與運轉後的篩面影像、壓差及流量，按位置記錄污損而非只報整體比例。檢查有效面積定義是否包含支架與邊框，再用相同定義比較不同設備及清理狀態。~Retain clean and operating screen images with pressure difference and flow, recording fouling by location rather than only an overall fraction. Check whether effective area includes frames and supports, then compare devices and cleaning states using consistent definitions.
units.failure: 重複扣除孔隙或完全忽略框架遮蔽都會算錯流速，均勻堵塞假設則可能高估局部可用面積；堵塞造成的壓差升高還會增加構件受力與泵吸入損失。~Double-counting porosity or ignoring frame obstruction miscalculates velocity, while uniform blockage can overstate local available area. Increased blockage pressure difference also raises structural loading and suction losses.
units.misconception: 篩網標示面積可以直接當成任何運轉狀態的有效過水面積。~A screen’s labeled area equals effective flow area under every operating condition.
units.practice: 建立由外框到有效開口的面積帳，逐項標示遮蔽與污損。比較相同總堵塞量集中於一角或均勻分布時的驗證需求，避免只用單一剩餘比例代表全部流場。~Build an area ledger from gross frame to effective openings, identifying structural and fouling reductions. Compare verification needs for concentrated and uniform blockage with the same total loss, avoiding one fraction as a complete flow-field description.

units.anchor: 取水損失與局部構件~Intake losses and local components
units.title: 取水損失與局部構件機理與驗證~Intake losses and local components mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 取水頭、彎管、格柵與管徑轉換都會消耗能量，局部損失係數必須對應指定速度截面與幾何。將不同來源的係數直接相加而不核對基準速度，可能造成錯誤揚程；污損與潮流還會改變入流方向，使清潔均勻來流下的係數不再代表長期運轉。本式對單一等效構件使用既定速度，未含沿程摩阻或所有篩網堵塞；損失水頭與靜水深度不可混為同一項。~Intake heads, bends, screens and transitions dissipate energy, and each local-loss coefficient refers to a particular velocity section and geometry. Adding coefficients from different references without checking velocity basis can miscalculate required head. Fouling and currents also change approach direction, so coefficients for clean uniform inflow need not represent long-term operation. The expression uses a specified velocity for one equivalent component, excluding distributed friction and complete screen fouling. Loss head and static submergence are distinct terms.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設K=2.0、基準速度v=1.5 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，局部損失hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume K=2.0, reference velocity v=1.5 m/s and g=9.81 m/s². Local loss hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m.
units.verify: 把每個損失係數的來源、速度基準與清潔狀態註記在水力帳，核對壓力取樣點的高程差。使用可比潮位和流量的量測驗證總損失，再區分局部構件與長管摩阻的貢獻。~Annotate coefficient source, velocity basis and cleanliness in the hydraulic ledger and check elevation differences between pressure taps. Validate total loss at comparable tide and flow, then separate contributions from local components and long-pipe friction.
units.failure: 使用錯誤截面速度會因平方關係放大壓損偏差，漏計污損則會高估泵吸入裕度；把水深當作可用揚程而不扣損失，也會錯判最低潮工況。~A wrong reference velocity amplifies loss error through its square, while omitted fouling overstates pump suction margin. Treating water depth as available head without subtracting losses also misrepresents the low-tide condition.
units.misconception: 所有局部損失係數都可直接相加而不必核對速度基準。~All local-loss coefficients can be added without checking their velocity basis.
units.practice: 為兩個不同管徑構件分別計算速度與損失，再換成同一能量帳比較。增加假設污損後重新檢查吸入端壓力，說明為何損失變化會連到設備性能。~Calculate velocity and loss for two components with different diameters before combining their energy contributions. Add hypothetical fouling and reassess suction pressure, explaining the connection between losses and machine performance.

units.anchor: 潮位與泵吸入裕度~Tide and pump suction margin
units.title: 潮位與泵吸入裕度機理與驗證~Tide and pump suction margin mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 海潮改變泵入口可用的靜水頭，而吸入管損失、海水溫度與大氣壓共同影響汽蝕裕度。淹水深度足夠也不必然消除入口渦流或不均勻速度，淨正吸入水頭與流場品質應分開驗證；設備要求值還需對應實際流量、轉速及試驗定義，不能只拿一個型錄數字比較。以下各項都已換算為同一海水密度下的水頭，吸入水面高於泵基準取正；比較餘量不是通用汽蝕允收標準。~Tides change static head available at a pump, while suction losses, seawater temperature and atmospheric pressure affect cavitation margin. Adequate submergence does not necessarily eliminate vortices or uneven velocity, so net positive suction head and intake flow quality require separate checks. Required values must match flow, speed and test definition rather than one catalog number. All terms are expressed as head using the same seawater density, with water surface above the pump datum positive. The calculated margin is not a universal cavitation acceptance criterion.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.0 m、靜淹水3.0 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.3 m、吸入損失1.5 m，NPSHa=11.2 m；若NPSHr=8.0 m，差3.2 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.0 m, static submergence 3.0 m, vapor head 0.3 m and suction loss 1.5 m. NPSHa=11.2 m; compared with NPSHr=8.0 m, the difference is 3.2 m.
units.verify: 以低潮、高溫及代表流量組合核對吸入水頭，將泵基準、壓力取樣與密度換算記錄完整。另用流場量測或模型查渦流和速度不均，避免把單一NPSH差值當成整體入口品質。~Check suction head for low tide, high temperature and representative flows, documenting pump datum, pressure taps and density conversion. Independently assess vortices and velocity distortion through measurements or modeling instead of treating one NPSH difference as complete intake quality.
units.failure: 將海水水頭與淡水水頭混用會帶入換算偏差，未考慮最低潮則可能高估可用裕度；入口渦流捲氣也可能在名目NPSH尚足夠時損害性能。~Mixing seawater and freshwater head introduces conversion bias, and omitting low tide can overstate available margin. Air entrainment from intake vortices can also impair performance while nominal NPSH appears adequate.
units.misconception: 淨正吸入水頭有正餘量就代表入口渦流與捲氣都不存在。~A positive NPSH margin proves that intake vortices and entrained air are absent.
units.practice: 把高潮與低潮兩個情境畫在同一泵基準上，分別扣除損失及蒸氣壓。將汽蝕水頭與渦流證據分列，說明需要哪種量測才能判斷各自問題。~Draw high- and low-tide cases against one pump datum and subtract losses and vapor head separately. Keep cavitation-head and vortex evidence distinct, identifying measurements capable of addressing each issue.

units.anchor: 地下取水與滲透能力~Subsurface intake and permeability
units.title: 地下取水與滲透能力機理與驗證~Subsurface intake and permeability mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 海床或岸邊地下取水藉地層傳輸海水，可能改變懸浮物及生物進入方式，但可用流量受滲透性、厚度、補注邊界與水質反應控制。單一鑽孔的高滲透層不能代表整個集水範圍，長期抽水還可能造成堵塞或改變混合水源；可行性必須由現地試驗與水文地質模型共同建立。達西算例假設均質飽和介質與一維穩定流，不表示任何海岸都可提供相同產能，也沒有估計水質或生態效益。~Subsurface intakes transmit seawater through sediment and can change suspended-solid and organism entry, but yield depends on permeability, thickness, recharge boundaries and geochemical reactions. One permeable borehole interval cannot represent the entire collection area. Long-term pumping can cause clogging or alter source mixing, so feasibility needs field testing together with a hydrogeological model. The Darcy example assumes homogeneous saturated material and steady one-dimensional flow. It does not imply equal yield at every coast or quantify quality and ecological benefits.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=5×10⁻⁴ m/s、截面A=300 m²、水力坡降i=0.10，Q=kAi=0.0150 m³/s，為理想介質比較。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=5×10⁻⁴ m/s, section A=300 m² and hydraulic gradient i=0.10. Q=kAi=0.0150 m³/s for an idealized medium.
units.verify: 以分層調查、抽水試驗及潮位反應建立滲透與邊界範圍，將進水水質和長期流量衰減一起觀察。比較多種地下取水配置，並連同主管機關對研究限制的說明閱讀可行性資料。~Establish permeability and boundary ranges from stratified investigation, pumping tests and tidal response, observing water quality with long-term yield decline. Compare several subsurface configurations and read feasibility material together with agency statements about study limitations.
units.failure: 只以短期高流量試驗外推長期產能可能忽略堵塞或補注不足，遇到細層連續阻隔時更會高估集水範圍；把技術比較報告當唯一許可依據也會混淆研究與審查。~Extrapolating short high-yield tests can miss clogging or limited recharge, and continuous fine layers can further shrink the collection area. Treating a comparison report as the sole permitting basis also confuses research with regulatory evaluation.
units.misconception: 地下取水只要量到一處高滲透層就能保證全廠長期供水。~One highly permeable layer guarantees long-term supply for the whole plant.
units.practice: 畫出均質地層與夾細層地層兩種概念模型，指出達西截面和流徑可能如何改變。為每個模型列出可推翻它的抽水或潮位觀察，再討論調查優先順序。~Draw homogeneous and fine-layered conceptual models, showing changes in Darcy area and flow path. Identify pumping or tidal observations that could falsify each model and use them to prioritize investigation.

units.anchor: 堵塞演變與水頭損失~Clogging evolution and head loss
units.title: 堵塞演變與水頭損失機理與驗證~Clogging evolution and head loss mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地下集水層或濾床的堵塞會改變有效滲透性，維持相同流量時可能需要更大水頭差。沉積、微生物與化學沉澱不一定以相同位置或速率發生，因此整體流量下降無法唯一辨認堵塞機制；應把水頭分布、顆粒與水化學共同追蹤，避免只增加抽吸來補償性能衰退。本式包含實際假設流徑長度，計算的是水頭差而不是無量綱坡降；介質均質且流量固定的條件不可省略。~Clogging in collection sediments or filters changes effective permeability, requiring greater head difference to maintain flow. Deposition, biological growth and precipitation need not occur at the same location or rate, so declining yield cannot uniquely identify the mechanism. Track head distribution, particles and chemistry together rather than compensating for deterioration only by increasing suction. The expression includes the assumed flow-path length and calculates head difference rather than dimensionless gradient. Homogeneous material and fixed-flow assumptions are essential.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=0.020 m³/s、L=2 m、k=1×10⁻⁴ m/s、A=100 m²，Δh=QL/(kA)=4.0 m；k減半時需8.0 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=0.020 m³/s, L=2 m, k=1×10⁻⁴ m/s and A=100 m². Δh=QL/(kA)=4.0 m; halving k requires 8.0 m at the same flow.
units.verify: 沿集水路徑量測水頭與流量，定期比較顆粒、化學及生物指標，將清理事件與恢復效果對時。用局部水頭變化辨認堵塞區，避免只由總壓差推斷全層均勻劣化。~Measure head and flow along the collection path and periodically compare particle, chemical and biological indicators, aligning cleaning events with recovery. Use local head changes to identify clogged zones rather than inferring uniform deterioration from the total pressure difference.
units.failure: 提高抽吸維持流量可能讓局部梯度和細粒移動增加，卻掩蓋滲透性持續下降；若壓力測點只設在兩端，集中堵塞的位置也可能一直無法辨識。~Increasing suction to hold flow can raise local gradients and fines movement while concealing continuing permeability loss. With pressure measurements only at both ends, the location of concentrated clogging may remain unidentified.
units.misconception: 只要提高抽吸就能無限制補償濾床或地下取水層的堵塞。~Increasing suction can compensate indefinitely for filter or subsurface-intake clogging.
units.practice: 在固定流量下比較原始與減半滲透性的水頭需求，再畫出集中堵塞與均勻堵塞的可能水頭線。選擇可區分兩者的中間量測點，避免只追蹤出口流量。~Compare head demand at original and halved permeability under fixed flow, then draw possible profiles for concentrated and uniform clogging. Select intermediate sensors that distinguish them instead of monitoring outlet flow alone.

units.anchor: 海管浮力與施工狀態~Marine-pipe buoyancy and construction state
units.title: 海管浮力與施工狀態機理與驗證~Marine-pipe buoyancy and construction state mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 海底管線在空管、充水與覆土後具有不同的淨重，浮力按排開海水體積計算而不是只看管材重量。施工階段尚未完成壓重或回填時可能最不利，波流作用又會同時增加滑動與抬升需求；因此永久穩定模型不能直接替代安裝、試驗或排空維護的階段模型。本例為一米長、外徑圓管的靜水浮力，假設空管且未計壓重；不含波流動力、土體吸附或海床接觸抗力。~A submarine pipe has different net weight when empty, flooded and buried. Buoyancy follows displaced seawater volume rather than pipe-material weight alone. Installation before ballast or cover may govern, while waves and currents add sliding and uplift demands. Permanent stability therefore cannot replace separate installation, testing or drained-maintenance models. This is static buoyancy for a one-metre circular outside diameter, assuming an empty unballasted pipe. Wave/current forces, soil suction and seabed resistance are excluded.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外徑D=1.20 m、海水單位重γ=10.055 kN/m³、空管重w=6.0 kN/m，淨上浮u=γπD²/4−w=5.372 kN/m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume outside D=1.20 m, seawater unit weight γ=10.055 kN/m³ and empty-pipe weight w=6.0 kN/m. Net uplift u=γπD²/4−w=5.372 kN/m.
units.verify: 為各施工階段核對充水狀態、壓重配置與外徑，將單位長度重量和海床接觸範圍列入同一帳。另依核定海事條件檢查波流作用與支承，避免靜態重量比通過就跳過階段穩定。~Verify flooding state, ballast and outside diameter for every construction stage, recording unit weight with seabed contact. Independently assess wave/current actions and support under approved marine conditions rather than skipping staged stability after a static weight-ratio check.
units.failure: 把永久覆土重量提早計入尚未回填的管段會低估上浮，排空維修時若忘記扣除內水重也可能使既有穩定判斷失效；局部浮起還會改變接頭彎曲。~Crediting permanent cover before placement understates uplift, and forgetting the loss of internal water weight during draining invalidates stability assumptions. Local lift-off also changes joint bending demands.
units.misconception: 海管永久狀態穩定就代表空管施工或排空維修時也一定穩定。~Permanent stability guarantees stability during empty-pipe construction or drained maintenance.
units.practice: 將空管、充水與覆土三個狀態的重量和浮力逐項列出，指出哪些項目會變。把淨垂向力與抗滑、接頭及動態問題分開，建立分階段驗證表。~List weight and buoyancy for empty, flooded and buried states, identifying changing terms. Separate net vertical force from sliding, joint and dynamic issues in a staged verification table.

units.anchor: 生物暴露與取樣代表性~Biological exposure and sampling representation
units.title: 生物暴露與取樣代表性機理與驗證~Biological exposure and sampling representation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 取水可能使生物撞擊篩面或隨水進入系統，兩種途徑的體型、生命階段與評估方法不同。濃度乘取水量可估接觸或輸送數量，但死亡率、避讓與季節分布須另有證據；短期平均樣本若漏掉繁殖季或潮汐高峰，可能低估真正暴露，不能用單次低濃度宣稱影響微小。此算例假設濃度及流量在時段內均勻，得到的是潛在通過數量而非死亡數；實際需考慮空間分布與取樣效率。~Organisms may be impinged on screens or entrained into the system, with different sizes, life stages and assessment methods. Concentration times intake volume estimates encounter or transport count, while mortality, avoidance and seasonal distribution need separate evidence. Short mean samples can miss spawning or tidal peaks, so one low concentration cannot establish negligible impact. The example assumes uniform concentration and flow over the interval and gives potential passage count rather than mortality. Spatial distribution and sampling efficiency remain separate.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設生物濃度C=2 individuals/m³、Q=1.0 m³/s、Δt=600 s，潛在通過數N=CQΔt=1200 individuals，未乘死亡比例。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume organism concentration C=2 individuals/m³, Q=1.0 m³/s and Δt=600 s. Potential count N=CQΔt=1200 individuals, with no mortality fraction applied.
units.verify: 按物種與生命階段規劃季節、潮汐及深度取樣，核對網具或感測方法的捕獲效率。將暴露估計、存活資料與背景變動分開報告，對未觀測季節保留不確定性而非補成零。~Plan sampling by species and life stage across seasons, tides and depths, checking capture efficiency of nets or sensors. Report exposure, survival evidence and background variability separately, retaining uncertainty for unobserved periods instead of replacing them with zero.
units.failure: 把潛在通過數直接稱為死亡數會混淆機制，反之以篩網擋住大魚便推定幼生也受保護則會漏掉不同尺度風險；不完整取樣可讓兩種錯誤同時存在。~Calling potential passage count mortality confuses mechanisms, while protection of large fish does not demonstrate protection of larvae. Incomplete sampling can allow both errors to persist simultaneously.
units.misconception: 濃度乘取水量算出的生物數就等於已證明的死亡數。~Concentration times intake volume equals proven biological mortality.
units.practice: 把暴露量、受傷率與存活率畫成不同資料欄位，說明何時可以及不可以相乘。以兩個季節的假設濃度比較結果，指出長期評估需要的代表性樣本。~Separate exposure, injury and survival into distinct data fields, explaining when multiplication is justified. Compare hypothetical concentrations in two seasons and identify representative sampling needed for long-term assessment.

units.anchor: 排放回流與取水水質~Outfall recirculation and intake quality
units.title: 排放回流與取水水質機理與驗證~Outfall recirculation and intake quality mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 取水與排放位置不能各自孤立設計，濃鹽水在潮流轉向、弱流或密度流條件下可能重新進入取水區。回流會提高進水鹽度並改變膜系統能耗及濃水條件，形成系統回饋；只看兩管水平距離不足以判定獨立，需把三維水深、分層及季節水動力一起分析。此例以質量分率混合兩股海水，鹽度用g/kg，沒有混用體積分率；它不預測實際回流比例，該比例需由水動力及現場資料決定。~Intake and outfall cannot be designed independently: brine can return toward the intake during current reversal, weak flow or density-driven transport. Recirculation raises feed salinity and changes membrane energy and concentrate conditions, creating feedback. Horizontal separation alone cannot prove independence; three-dimensional bathymetry, stratification and seasonal hydrodynamics must be assessed together. The example mixes two streams by mass fraction with salinity in g/kg, not volume fraction. It does not predict actual recirculation, which requires hydrodynamic and field evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設背景鹽度S0=35 g/kg、回流水Sr=45 g/kg、回流質量分率f=0.10，Sint=(1−f)S0+fSr=36.0 g/kg。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume background S0=35 g/kg, returning water Sr=45 g/kg and returning mass fraction f=0.10. Sint=(1−f)S0+fSr=36.0 g/kg.
units.verify: 將取排水鹽度、溫度與海流剖面同步量測，涵蓋潮流反轉及低交換時段。比較適用的近場與遠場模型，保留背景鹽度變化，避免把所有進水升鹽都歸因於本廠排放。~Synchronize intake/outfall salinity and temperature with current profiles, covering reversals and weak exchange. Compare suitable near- and far-field models while retaining natural background variation rather than attributing every feed-salinity increase to the plant’s discharge.
units.failure: 忽略回流可能低估膜進水負荷與排放濃度，若又以升高後的取水鹽度當自然背景，會把排放造成的長期增加藏進基線，形成自我合理化的比較。~Ignoring recirculation can understate feed loading and discharge salinity. If the elevated intake salinity is then treated as natural background, long-term discharge effects are hidden inside the baseline and appear self-justifying.
units.misconception: 只要取水口與排放口有一定水平距離就絕對不會回流。~A horizontal separation between intake and outfall guarantees no recirculation.
units.practice: 用兩個假設回流質量分率比較進水鹽度，再指出為何需另解潮流與密度輸送。設計上游背景與取水點的同步比較，避免以受影響水體充當未受影響基線。~Compare feed salinity at two assumed returning mass fractions and explain why tidal and density transport still need separate solution. Design synchronized background and intake observations without using affected water as an unaffected baseline.

example: 原創敏感度例設定產品水0.50 m³/s，膜段回收率45%時需進水1.111 m³/s；只把回收率降至40%，進水增為1.250 m³/s，增加12.5%。若有效篩面維持10 m²，平均法向速度隨之由0.1111增至0.1250 m/s。這只是膜段與理想均勻篩面的聯動，尚未加入反洗、堵塞與物種條件。接著應以全廠水量帳及局部流場檢查結果，再比較地下取水的水文地質可行性。數值不是兩座西澳案例的操作參數，也不是推薦取水或生態門檻。~An original sensitivity example supplies product water at 0.50 m³/s. Membrane recovery of 45% requires feed 1.111 m³/s; lowering only recovery to 40% increases feed to 1.250 m³/s, a 12.5% rise. With effective screen area fixed at 10 m², mean normal velocity rises from 0.1111 to 0.1250 m/s. This couples only the membrane balance and an ideally uniform screen, omitting backwash, blockage and species conditions. Check the result against the complete plant balance and local flow field, then compare hydrogeological feasibility of subsurface alternatives. These values are neither operating parameters from the Western Australian cases nor recommended intake or ecological limits.
history: 海淡取水將供水能力、海洋環境與海岸地質連在一起，公開案例可用來比較調查方法而非移植尺寸。西澳伯斯奎那那廠於2006年開始產水，賓寧納普南部廠於2011年開始產水。加州於2015年將海淡取排水議題納入海洋計畫，後續地下取水專家報告須連同2025年主管機關回應閱讀，回應明示它不能作唯一合規指南。本課因此將公開歷史、研究限制與原創算例分開，不從單一海岸案例推定其他地點的取水可行性。~Desalination intakes connect supply capacity, marine ecology and coastal geology. Public cases support comparison of investigation methods rather than transfer of dimensions. Kwinana’s Perth plant began production in 2006 and the Southern plant at Binningup in 2011. California incorporated desalination intake and discharge issues into its Ocean Plan in 2015. A later subsurface-intake panel report must be read with the 2025 agency response, which states that it is not a sole compliance guide. This course separates public history, study limitations and original examples rather than transferring feasibility from one coastline to another.

timeline.event: 伯斯奎那那海淡廠開始產水，形成海域取排水比較案例。~The Perth Kwinana plant begins production, providing a marine intake/outfall comparison.
賓寧納普南部海淡廠開始產水，連接區域供水系統。~The Southern plant at Binningup begins production and connects to regional supply.
加州主管機關回應地下取水報告，明示研究與合規依據的限制。~California’s agency responds to the subsurface-intake report, clarifying its limitations.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Feed Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s and concentrate Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s. Required effective area Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m².

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外框A=20 m²、孔隙率φ=0.60、通暢比例β=0.75，Aeff=Aφβ=9.0 m²；Q=1.20 m³/s時vn=0.1333 m/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross A=20 m², open-area ratio φ=0.60 and unblocked fraction β=0.75. Aeff=Aφβ=9.0 m²; at Q=1.20 m³/s, vn=0.1333 m/s.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設K=2.0、基準速度v=1.5 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，局部損失hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume K=2.0, reference velocity v=1.5 m/s and g=9.81 m/s². Local loss hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.0 m、靜淹水3.0 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.3 m、吸入損失1.5 m，NPSHa=11.2 m；若NPSHr=8.0 m，差3.2 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.0 m, static submergence 3.0 m, vapor head 0.3 m and suction loss 1.5 m. NPSHa=11.2 m; compared with NPSHr=8.0 m, the difference is 3.2 m.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=5×10⁻⁴ m/s、截面A=300 m²、水力坡降i=0.10，Q=kAi=0.0150 m³/s，為理想介質比較。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=5×10⁻⁴ m/s, section A=300 m² and hydraulic gradient i=0.10. Q=kAi=0.0150 m³/s for an idealized medium.
